On Monday, July 3, 2023 at 5:15:41 PM UTC+10 talim...@gmail.com wrote:
Hi everyone,

I have Dart data that I process mostly with dartR when I can. I need to run fastimcoal2, and found that 'gl.sfs' generates an SFS file from a genlight object. However, when I try to run fastsimcoal2 in the command line on a cluster, the file is read as a 'jointMAF' file (i.e., multiple populations). 

Here is my data:
#my gl object:
gl
******************** *** DARTR OBJECT *** ******************** ** 160 genotypes, 3,674 SNPs , size: 18.5 Mb missing data: 0 (=0 %) scored as NA ** Genetic data @gen: list of 160 SNPbin @ploidy: ploidy of each individual (range: 2-2) ** Additional data @ind.names: 160 individual labels @loc.names: 3674 locus labels @loc.all: 3674 allele labels @position: integer storing positions of the SNPs [within 69 base sequence] @pop: population of each individual (group size range: 160-160) @other: a list containing: loc.metrics, ind.metrics, loc.metrics.flags, verbose, history, neophobia, innovation_easy, innovation_difficult, country @other$ind.metrics: X, Sample.effort, Source, Source__, Range, Locality, Modern_loc, Pop, neophobia, innovation_easy, innovation_difficult, Country, Land_Type, Latitude, Longtitude, Year, Years_since_introduction, Sex, Age, Wing_len_mm, Tarsus_length, Premaxilla, Bill_length, Bill_depth, Bill_width, Head_length, Middle_toe, Moulting_code, ALT, HD.factor_NEW, HD, Updated_HD, IMP, Updated_IMP, dtr, pet, pre, tmn, tmx, tmp, id, service, plate_location @other$loc.metrics: AlleleID, CloneID, AlleleSequence, TrimmedSequence, Chrom_acterias_NCI, ChromPos_acterias_NCI, AlnCnt_acterias_NCI, AlnEvalue_acterias_NCI, Chrom_AmericanCrow_v01, ChromPos_AmericanCrow_v01, AlnCnt_AmericanCrow_v01, AlnEvalue_AmericanCrow_v01, Chrom_Yellow_roin_v1, ChromPos_Yellow_roin_v1, AlnCnt_Yellow_roin_v1, AlnEvalue_Yellow_roin_v1, Chrom_est_others, ChromPos_est_others, AlnCnt_est_others, AlnEvalue_est_others, Chrom_Finch_v75, ChromPos_Finch_v75, AlnCnt_Finch_v75, AlnEvalue_Finch_v75, SNP, SnpPosition, CallRate, OneRatioRef, OneRatioSnp, FreqHomRef, FreqHomSnp, FreqHets, PICRef, PICSnp, AvgPIC, AvgCountRef, AvgCountSnp, RepAvg, clone, uid, rdepth, monomorphs, maf, OneRatio, PIC @other$latlon[g]: no coordinates attached

#My code for generating SFS
obs.p<-gl.sfs(gl,singlepop = T)

#How I exported it
write.csv(sfs, "IL_sfs.obs") #And then I corrected it in notepad++

#My code for command line fastsimcoal2

~/fsc27_linux64/fsc2705  -t ~/fsc27_linux64/myna.tpl -e ~/fsc27_linux64/myna.est -m ~/fsc27_linux64/myna_MAFpop0.obs -n 10000 -C 1 -L 40 -s 0 -M -g 

#The error I get when running fastsimcoal2
Observed data file ("../myna_jointMAFpop0_0.obs") does not seem to be present
Unable to compute the likelihood
TSimSettings::performBrenMinimization: Unable to read observed SFS and to estimate parameters ...
The same thing happens if I run fsc through strataG (code is similar), which makes me think that something in my initial conversion to SFS is incorrect.

Is there anything in the original gl.sfs function that I should specify differently?

Thank you,

Tali
